## API Doc (expanded)



docs/api/quickstart - API Quickstart - Get started with the Zen Mesh API with curl, Python, and JavaScript examples
docs/api/authentication - Authentication - How to authenticate with API tokens and handle 401 errors
docs/api/errors - Common API Errors - Reference for HTTP status codes and error handling


- [OpenAPI Reference](./api/openapi-reference) - Interactive API reference rendered from the canonical OpenAPI specification
  - Live YAML: https://docs.zen-mesh.io/openapi/zen-mesh-user-api.v1.yaml
  - Live JSON: https://docs.zen-mesh.io/openapi/zen-mesh-user-api.v1.json
  - Zen Mesh User API (v1-preview, 19 endpoints)
- [Fabric Adapters API](./api/fabric-adapters) - Adapter management guide
- [API Overview](./api/overview) - Introduction to Zen Mesh APIs
- [Authentication](./api/authentication) - Authentication and authorization
